content:
incident-bot: ALERT — High error rate on payments-webhook-prod (stripe). 22% deliveries failing in the last 5m. Pager triggered for #oncall-frontend. https://status.stripe.com/ (automated)

oncall-frontend: Ack. seeing a spike in 5xx/4xx from Stripe webhook endpoints. Customers reporting missing payment confirmations.

oncall-platform: I'm in. can anyone paste the top error codes from the webhook retry logs?

megan: Logs show repeated 403 + 429 from Stripe on POST /v1/events -> sample headers: `Retry-After: 30`, body `{"error":{"type":"rate_limit","message":"You have exceeded your API request rate limit"}}`. Also a subset of requests got `{"error":{"message":"account_inactive","type":"invalid_request_error"}}` around the same time.

sam: Confirmed. We have 429s with Retry-After and 403/401 variants. Reasonable hypothesis: Stripe started enforcing a limit or flagged the account due to billing/overdue invoice. status.stripe.com has some maintenance notes but nothing explicit about limits.

ivy: Customer-facing impact: payment webhooks not delivered => order fulfillment stalled for some merchants and in-app purchase flows are failing. Severity: P1 for affected customers on Dedicated plans; broader P2 for general users.

oncall-frontend: Quick mitigation ideas: 1) enable local webhook replay queue (we have queued events in S3) 2) switch to our retry proxy that throttles to Stripe with exponential backoff 3) enable degraded mode that shows "processing" UI to customers instead of error. I'll start 1 & 2.

megan: Starting a throttled relay now: `./scripts/relay_to_stripe --source s3://webhook-queue/2026/03/15 --rate 5/s --retry-after-header` (will honor Retry-After). Pushing a canary to a single customer to validate.

oncall-platform: Opening a support ticket with Stripe and escalating — raising ticket via dashboard now, pinging enterprise support. Include logs and evidence of quota headers. sam, can you paste the curl example we captured? would be helpful.

sam: Curl snippet of failing request:

```
curl -i -X POST https://api.stripe.com/v1/events \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_***" \
  -d '{"type":"checkout.session.completed"}'

HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Retry-After: 30
Content-Type: application/json
{"error":{"type":"rate_limit","message":"You have exceeded your API request rate limit"}}
```

megan: Also saw responses with:

```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{"error":{"type":"invalid_request_error","message":"account_inactive"}}
```

oncall-platform: Stripe support ticket opened: https://support.stripe.com/tickets/INC-8675309 (ticket id in internal UI). I attached delivery logs and merchant list. Escalation to Priority requested — waiting on human.

ops-bot: Incident created: STRIPE-WEBHOOK-2026-03-15-1769954321. Pager duty updated, incident commander: megan.

megan: Command: switch payment-status UI to "pending" for transactions created in the last 10m to avoid customer confusion. I'll push the UI toggle now.

ivy: Notifications: we need to notify impacted merchants via status page and support template. I'll draft a message: short explanation + ETA unknown + mitigation steps. cc: sales & success.

sam: Running a quick audit for downstream systems dependent on webhook latency (fulfillment queues, notification jobs). If webhooks are missing, our replay will create duplicates; ensure idempotency keys are enforced when relaying.

oncall-frontend: Handoff plan: megan will remain IC for next 2h, then hand over to oncall-platform night shift. Leave runbook notes in the thread.

megan: Runbook notes:
- We have queued events in s3://webhook-queue/2026-03-15
- Use relay script with `--honor-retry-after` and rate limit set to 5rps per account.
- Monitor `payments-webhook-prod` -> delivery_success_rate metric and Stripe HTTP 429 count.
- If Stripe returns consistent 403/account_inactive across >50% of merchants, escalate to Sales for billing outreach.

oncall-platform: Update: Stripe responded on the ticket — they see a billing hold applied to the account due to overdue invoices which can cause temporary rate limiting and webhook deliveries to be deprioritized. They estimate resolution in 2-4 hours after invoice payment clears. Support gave a temporary API allowance for urgent transactions if we can provide merchant IDs.

ivy: Ok, that matches our findings. Immediate next steps: 1) continue relay with conservative rate limits and idempotency 2) send merchant-facing status + support articles 3) Sales to coordinate payment resolution for impacted merchants.

megan: Notifying Sales & Finance to help clear any invoices for accounts that are blocked. @sam can you share the top impacted merchant IDs in the ticket so Stripe can whitelist/allow temporary deliveries?

sam: Pasted list into ticket, and emailed account reps.

oncall-frontend: Customer comms posted to status.redwood.com: "We are experiencing delayed payment confirmations for some merchants due to a third-party payment provider rate-limiting and billing holds. We are mitigating by replaying events and working with the provider. Some transactions may show as pending for a short time." Added link to support doc.

ops-bot: Reaction: :eyes: on incident thread. Severity set to P1 for affected merchants.

megan: Metrics now: delivery_fail_rate back down from 22% -> 6% after throttled relay. Still seeing intermittent 429s when relay rate > ~7rps.

oncall-platform: Plan for next 2 hours: keep relay at 5rps, monitor Retry-After headers, escalate to Stripe if they can provide temporary allowance for our critical merchant list. Prepare postmortem skeleton: timeline, root cause (Stripe billing hold), mitigations (relay, UI degrade, merchant outreach), and follow-ups (billing SLA, fallback provider investigation).

ivy: Will coordinate customer emails and support routing. Sales is on standby to assist with payment clears.

megan: Handoff: I'm tagging @oncall-platform as next IC at 1769957600. Leaving link to ticket and runbook in the incident doc. If anything changes (wider 403 spike or Stripe status update), call the page again.

oncall-platform: Acked, taking over IC. Leaving a short note for night shift: maintain relay, keep rate <=5rps, watch for 403 bulk increases, escalate to stripe-support email thread if needed.

stripe-support: (external) We have confirmed billing hold on the account; engineering has opened a temporary allowance path for whitelisted merchants. Working with customer contacts provided.

megan: Closing note: customer impact contained, mitigations in progress, further updates in ticket. Preparing post-incident report once Stripe confirms full resolution and all queued webhooks are replayed.

oncall-platform: Closing the page for now but incident remains open until Stripe resolves billing hold. Next update planned in 30m or on Stripe status change"
